output.reply: Hi Maria, thanks for reaching out and sorry about the double charge. I've flagged the duplicate $9.99 Lumen Plus charge from the 3rd for review and refund. Once it's confirmed, the refund typically appears on your card within 5-10 business days. We'll email you as soon as it's processed. If you can reply with the last 4 digits of the card used, that will help us locate both transactions quickly. Best, Lumen Support

Thanks for the suggestion! Automatic dark mode that follows your system setting is a great idea, and I've passed it along to our product team. I can't promise a timeline, but requests like this help us decide what to build next. For now, you'll still need to switch themes manually in Settings, but we'll let you know if this becomes available.

Hi there! Thanks for reaching out. To export your notes as Markdown, open Settings, go to Data & Backup, choose Export All Notes, and select Markdown (.md) as the format. You'll receive a ZIP file with one .md file per note, organized by notebook. If you have a large library, the export may take a few minutes and we'll email you a download link when it's ready. If you don't see the export option or run into any trouble, let us know your platform (web, iOS, Android, or desktop) and we'll walk you through it. Safe travels!

Hi there, sorry you're locked out. Since the reset link goes to your old inbox, we'll need to verify your identity before updating the email on your account. Please reply with the old email address on the account, the approximate date you created it, and the last few notes' titles or a recent billing detail if you have one. Once we confirm it's you, we'll switch the account to your new email address and send a fresh reset link there. If you still have any device where you're signed in to Lumen, you can also go to Settings > Account > Email to change it yourself right away. Thanks for your patience!

Hi there, I'm sorry about this, and I understand the pressure with your presentation coming up. We're treating this as an urgent outage report for your team. Since the status page shows all systems operational, this may be isolated to your network or region, so please try the following while we investigate: 1) Open web.lumen.app in a browser to check whether it loads. 2) Try a different network, such as a mobile hotspot. 3) If you have the desktop or mobile app, check whether previously opened notes are available offline. Please reply with your team's approximate location, your workspace name, and a screenshot of the error, and we'll escalate to our engineers right away. Your notes are safely stored and aren't lost.

Thanks for reporting this, and sorry for the trouble. It sounds like a regression in how Lumen web handles table pastes from Google Sheets, since it worked fine last week. To help us investigate, could you let us know: 1) whether pasting into a brand-new note gives the same result, 2) whether it happens in another browser or in an Incognito window with extensions disabled, and 3) a quick screenshot or short screen recording of the paste. As a temporary workaround, you can try Paste without formatting (Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+V) or paste the table into a Lumen table block manually. We've logged this with our engineering team and will update you as soon as we have more information.

Hi there! To share a notebook in Lumen: open the notebook, click the Share button (top right), then enter the email addresses of the people you'd like to invite or click 'Copy link' to generate a shareable link. You can choose whether each person can view or edit. You can change or remove access at any time from the same Share menu. Let us know if you run into any trouble!

Thanks for flagging this! You're right: the footer word count shows 0 for notes that contain only emoji, since emoji aren't counted as words. We've logged it with our team as a minor display issue. It doesn't affect your note content in any way. We'll let you know if there's an update on a fix.

Hi there, thanks for reaching out, and I'm sorry for the trouble. Sync stuck on 'Syncing...' across multiple devices, along with search returning no results, suggests a problem that may be on our side rather than with your devices. We're looking into it now. In the meantime, your notes are safe and stored locally on each device, so please avoid uninstalling the app or signing out until sync resumes. If you can share your app version and whether you see any error messages, that will help us investigate. We'll update you as soon as we have more information.

Hi there, thanks for the detailed feedback. A version history that shows who edited a note and when is a great suggestion, especially for a team of 12 that collaborates daily. I've logged it as a feature request with our product team and noted that your team would be willing to pay for it. I can't promise a timeline, but we'll update you if it moves forward. In the meantime, if you tell us roughly when the paragraph was deleted, we can check whether we're able to help recover it. Thanks for using Lumen!

Hi there! To update the display name shown next to your comments, open Settings > Profile, edit the Display Name field, and click Save. Your new name should appear on new comments right away. If older comments still show your previous nickname after a refresh or sign-out and back in, let us know and we'll take a closer look. Thanks for using Lumen!

Hi there, thanks for the suggestions! We've logged all three requests with our product team: pinning notes to the top of a notebook, a default font size setting, and extending trash retention from 30 to 60 days. I can't promise timelines, but feedback like this helps us prioritize what to build next. We'll let you know if any of these ship. Thanks for helping improve Lumen!

Hello,

Thanks for reaching out. We can issue an invoice that shows your company details. I've noted the following for the invoice:

VAT number: DE123456789

Lumen Support

Hi there, sorry the update made Settings harder to find. To turn off the weekly summary emails, open Settings, go to Notifications (or Email Preferences), and switch off the Weekly Summary toggle. If the menu layout looks different on your device, tell us which platform and app version you're using and we'll point you to the exact spot. Thanks for your patience, and we appreciate the feedback on the new layout.

Hi there, thanks for reaching out and sorry for the trouble. I can see you were charged $48 for the Lumen Team upgrade, but your account is still showing the free plan, which is why your two teammates can't access shared notebooks. I've flagged this to our billing team to manually sync your subscription and activate Team features. Once that's done, your teammates should be able to see the shared notebooks (having them log out and back in may help). Could you please confirm the email address on your account and the email addresses of the two teammates you invited? We'll update you as soon as the plan is corrected, and if the upgrade can't be applied we'll issue a full refund.

Hi there, I'm very sorry about the unexpected $120 annual plan charge, especially after you cancelled in March. I understand how frustrating this is. I've flagged your account for an urgent billing review today. To speed things up, please reply with your cancellation confirmation email (or a screenshot of it) and the email address on your Lumen account. Once we verify the cancellation, we will process a full refund right away. Refunds typically appear within 5-10 business days depending on your bank. Thank you for your patience while we get this resolved.

Hi, I'm sorry about this, especially with your exam on Friday. We're treating it as a high-priority issue. In the meantime, you can try these steps to get to your slides: 1) Open Lumen on the web at our website or on a computer, where your notes and attached PDFs should still be available to view and download. 2) If you can't reach a computer, try updating to the latest version of the app in the App Store, then force-quit and reopen it. Please also reply with your iOS version, iPhone/iPad model, and app version so our team can investigate quickly. Your notes and attachments have not been deleted. We'll follow up as soon as we have a fix.

Hola, lamentamos los inconvenientes para acceder a tu cuenta. Para ayudarte mejor, ¿podrías confirmarnos el correo electrónico asociado a tu cuenta de Lumen? Mientras tanto, te sugerimos revisar la carpeta de spam o correo no deseado, y comprobar que no haya errores de escritura en la dirección al solicitar el restablecimiento. Si los correos siguen sin llegar, verificaremos manualmente el estado de tu cuenta y te enviaremos un nuevo enlace de restablecimiento desde nuestro lado. Quedamos atentos a tu respuesta.

Thanks for the suggestion! An Android home screen widget is a great idea, and I've passed it along to our product team. We can't promise a timeline, but requests like yours help shape our roadmap. Hi, thank you for reporting this right away. It sounds like your account may have been accessed without your permission, so please take these steps now: 1) Reset your password from the login page and choose a new, unique one. 2) Sign out of all devices under Settings > Security. 3) Enable two-factor authentication. 4) Open the two affected notebooks, go to Share settings, and remove the unfamiliar address. We are flagging your account for a priority security review, and our team will check recent login activity and sharing changes and follow up with you shortly. If you notice any other unfamiliar activity, reply here and we will help immediately.

Thanks for reporting these two issues on Lumen for Windows. We've logged both as bugs: (1) the multi-second freeze when opening notebooks with 200+ notes, and (2) Ctrl+B occasionally inserting a literal 'b' instead of applying bold. To help our engineers reproduce them, could you share your Lumen version, Windows version, and keyboard layout/language? For the Ctrl+B issue, it would also help to know whether it happens right after opening a notebook or after the app has been idle. In the meantime, you can apply bold from the formatting toolbar. We'll update you as soon as we have a fix or more information.

Hello, and thank you for the kind words and for using Lumen for your research! It's wise to ask before reorganizing. I don't want to give you inaccurate details about how links, comments, and edit history behave when notes are moved or notebooks are merged, so I'm confirming the exact behavior with our product team and will get back to you shortly. In the meantime, a safe way to test is to duplicate one or two notebooks, or create a small test notebook with a few cross-linked notes, and try moving and merging those first. It's also a good idea to export a full backup of your notebooks before you begin the larger reorganization. I'll follow up as soon as I have a confirmed answer for you.

Hi there, I'm sorry the mobile app is showing as unavailable again, especially on a third Monday morning in a row. That pattern is frustrating and we're escalating it to our engineering team now so they can look into the recurring cause. In the meantime, your notes are safe and you can still access them through the web app. Could you let us know your device type, app version, and the approximate time the error started? That will help us pinpoint the issue. Thank you for your patience, and we'll follow up as soon as we have an update.

Hi, I'm sorry you're locked out, and I understand how time-sensitive this is. Because your two-factor device is unavailable and you don't have recovery codes, we'll need to verify your identity before restoring access. Please reply from the email address registered to your account with: the approximate date you created the account, the last 4 digits of any payment method on file (if applicable), and a few recent note titles or notebook names. Once we verify these details, we can reset your two-factor authentication and clear the login lockout. I've marked this as high priority given your deadline, and we'll follow up as quickly as possible.

Hi there, thanks for reaching out, and sorry about the broken image icons. We don't have a manual re-link setting for imported attachments, so the fix is usually to re-import. Before you do, please check that you exported from Evernote as an .enex file with attachments included, and that the file wasn't split or compressed in a way that dropped the media. To re-import cleanly, delete the affected imported notebook in Lumen (or rename it so you can compare the two), then run the import again from Settings > Import > Evernote. If the images are still broken after a fresh import, please reply with the size of your .enex file, roughly how many notes are affected, and a screenshot of one broken note, and we'll investigate whether this is an import bug. Thanks for your patience!

Hello, and thank you for considering Lumen for your team of 200. L'équipe Lumen

Hi there, thanks for reaching out! I'm sorry I can't confirm the exact steps for saving a note as a template in Lumen from here, and I don't want to point you to a menu option that may not exist in your version. Since you need this by end of day, here's a reliable workaround: create your standup note with the headings you want (e.g., Last Week, This Week, Blockers), then duplicate that note each week and rename it with the new date. If you'd like the whole team to reuse it, save the master copy in a shared notebook or folder so everyone can duplicate it from there. If you tell us which plan and platform (web, desktop, or mobile) you're on, we'll confirm whether a dedicated template feature is available for you and walk you through it. If it isn't, we'll log this as a feature request on your behalf.

Hi there, thanks for reaching out! To turn on offline mode, open Settings, choose Offline Access, and switch it on. Then open any notebook and toggle 'Available offline' so it downloads to your device. For notebooks shared with you, you can usually make them available offline the same way, as long as you have at least view access. Any edits you make offline will sync once you're back online. As for the Plus plan storage, I don't want to give you an incorrect number, so please check the Plans page under Settings > Billing for the current storage allowance, or reply here and a teammate will confirm the exact figure for you. Let us know if you have any other questions!

Hi there, sorry for the annoyance! You can stop Lumen from being flagged by right-clicking the underlined word and choosing 'Add to dictionary' (or 'Learn spelling'), which will add it to your custom dictionary so it won't be underlined again. If you'd rather turn spellcheck off entirely, go to Settings > Editor > Spellcheck and toggle it off. If the underline keeps coming back after adding it, let us know your device and app version and we'll dig in further.
